description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): fire one routine right now without waiting for its schedule: the task is created as if the time had passed (the schedule itself is unchanged). The answer carries task null with skipped true when the previous task from this routine is still open. Same as POST /v1/workspaces/:id/routines/:routine_id/run. Example: {"routine_id":"rtn_…"} (the id from list_routines).
name: run_routine
title: Run a routine now
